title: A Large-Scale Empirical Study of Quality Assurance Practices and Gaps in AI Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.17698v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based agents are increasingly used across software engineering, web automation, research, and productivity applications. Their integration of planning, memory, tool use, code execution, and external interactions enables greater autonomy but also introduces new reliability, safety, and security risks. We present a large-scale empirical study of quality assurance (QA) practices in 157 open-source LLM-based agent projects with at least 100 GitHub stars. We analyze documentation, source code, configurations, and tests to characterize QA practices across execution surfaces, safeguards, testing artifacts, risk scenarios, and recurring gaps. We find that current QA primarily focuses on basic functionality and high-risk actions, while coverage remains fragmented. translated_title: AI智能体质量保障实践与缺口的大规模实证研究
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体正日益广泛应用于软件工程、网页自动化、研究和生产力应用等领域。它们集成了规划、记忆、工具使用、代码执行和外部交互能力，从而实现了更高的自主性，但同时也引入了新的可靠性、安全性与安保风险。我们对157个GitHub星标数不低于100的开源LLM智能体项目的质量保障（QA）实践开展了大规模实证研究。通过分析文档、源代码、配置和测试，我们刻画了QA实践在执行面、防护措施、测试产物、风险场景以及反复出现的缺口等方面的现状。研究发现，当前的QA主要聚焦于基本功能和高风险操作，而覆盖范围仍然碎片化；防护措施在等效执行路径上的应用不一致；测试很少检验边界情况、对抗性场景或多步骤工具使用故障（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该研究对157个开源LLM智能体项目进行了大规模实证分析，发现当前质量保障实践主要覆盖基本功能与高风险操作，但在防护措施一致性、边界与对抗性测试以及多步骤工具使用故障检验方面存在显著缺口。
en_tdlr: This large-scale empirical study of 157 open-source LLM agent projects reveals that current QA practices mainly cover basic functionality and high-risk actions, while significant gaps remain in safeguard consistency, boundary and adversarial testing, and examination of multi-step tool-use failures.
